description: List members (people) of the workspace, filterable by exact email or name, location, company, status and creation/modification date. OfficeRnD: GET /members.

created_before.description: Only members created before this time (ISO 8601 date-time, e.g. 2026-01-01T00:00:00.000Z).

created_from.description: Only members created at or after this time (ISO 8601 date-time, e.g. 2026-01-01T00:00:00.000Z).

cursor_next.description: The cursorNext from the previous page. Omit for the first page.

cursor_prev.description: The cursorPrev from a page, to go one page back.

modified_since.description: Only items modified at or after this time (ISO 8601 date-time, e.g. 2026-01-01T00:00:00.000Z).

name: officernd_list_members
title: List members
